class.name: HeightmapFoliage3D
class.brief_description: Deterministically scatters large numbers of mesh instances over a terrain heightmap.
class.description: Places up to 100000 instances of [member foliage_mesh] on the [member heightmap] using a seeded random distribution and renders them through a single [MultiMesh]. Instances are sampled at the interpolated height of the terrain, randomly rotated around the up axis, and uniformly scaled. A slope filter prevents placement on steep ground. When the heightmap changes, placement is regenerated. [b]Note:[/b] This is a basic instance scatterer, not a full vegetation painter. It does not provide biome masks, physics collision, LOD/HLOD, procedural meshes, or streaming. The parent node should have the same transform and [member terrain_cell_size] as the corresponding [HeightmapTerrain3D].

method.name: get_generated_count
method.description: Returns the number of instances that passed the slope filter.

method.name: regenerate
method.description: Rebuilds all instances from the current seed and settings. Calling this repeatedly with unchanged inputs produces identical placements.
